subject: Discovery recap & next step — Greenlane inference
messages:
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.ai>
To: Samantha Price <samantha@greenlane.io>
Date: Tue, 15 Dec 2026 09:22:00 -0800
Subject: Discovery recap & next step — Greenlane inference

Hi Samantha — thanks again for carving out 35 minutes today. Quick recap from our side and a proposed next step so you can share with the team: 

Summary of what I heard:
- Primary goal: improve search relevance and product discovery with embeddings-driven reranking for web + mobile.
- Latency target: p95 < 100ms on product pages.
- Data constraints: PII-scrubbing required; prefer Private deployment (VPC) or dedicated tenancy for Q1 pilot.
- Cost sensitivity: target ~30% lower per-token cost vs current managed provider; pilot budget ~ $20k.

Suggested next steps:
1) 15-min technical sync (small group: your infra/product + our infra lead) to validate VPC/network requirements and latency expectations.
2) If alignment, short 4-week pilot with a single storefront reproducer and a dedicated GPU pool.

I attached a short one-pager that maps how Redwood would hit the latency/cost target and a sample pilot plan (redwood-quick-impact.pdf). If helpful, here are two windows I have this week: Thu 12/17 10–11am PT or Fri 12/18 2–3pm PT — otherwise you can pick any slot here: https://calendly.com/vanessa-ortiz/15min.

If this sounds off from what you heard, tell me and I’ll adjust. Appreciate any signal on priority — if this is not Q1-ready for Greenlane we’ll follow up later.

Thanks,
Vanessa Ortiz
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
vanessa@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0147

Attachments: redwood-quick-impact.pdf
